subject: Kickoff: vendor questionnaire start — SOC 2 / HIPAA scope + clarifying asks
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novabio.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: vendor questionnaire start — SOC 2 / HIPAA scope + clarifying asks

Hi Elena — thanks again for taking the call earlier. Quick recap and a handful of clarifying questions so our security team can scope the right intake path (SIG vs CAIQ vs custom):

Recap of what we heard on the call:
- NovaBio will be integrating Redwood for model inference in two environments: EU production for patient-facing analytics (PHI in scope) and a US sandbox for research (non-PHI).
- High-level asks: BAA, SOC 2 evidence (you mentioned SOC 2 in progress), encryption details (at-rest + in-transit), and audit log retention.

Clarifying questions to help us pick the right questionnaire and assemble evidence quickly:
1) SOC 2 status: is NovaBio asking for a current Type II report, or is a Type I / in-progress attestation acceptable for the prefill step? Any hard deadline?
2) HIPAA/PHI scope: can you list the specific endpoints or data flows that will carry PHI (API routes, S3 buckets, direct DB access)? We need this to map controls and BAA scope.
3) Encryption & keys: do you require customer-managed keys (BYOK) for at-rest encryption, or is provider-managed KMS acceptable for now?
4) Data residency: you confirmed EU residency for production — do you also require EU-only backups and log storage, or is cross-region replication allowed under contract with controls?
5) Evidence format/transfer: do you prefer a prefilled CAIQ (fast) then SIG for attachments, or start directly with a SIG? Also confirm preferred upload method for artifacts (shared Drive link vs DocuSign bundle vs secure SFTP).

Next steps I propose:
- I attach a short SIG starter (fields we typically prefill) and a one-page mutual action plan. If you confirm answers above by EOD Monday (May 18) we can deliver a prefill + initial evidence pack by May 26.
- Kimberly (CC) will lead the technical evidence mapping and Dev will scope any infra-level asks.

Attachments: Redwood_SIG_starter_v1.xlsx (sig prefill template)

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-minute follow-up if that helps.

Best,
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0141

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novabio.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 09:06:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vendor questionnaire start — SOC 2 / HIPAA scope + clarifying asks

Thanks Markus — appreciate the clear recap. Answers inline below and a couple of attachments from our side.

1) SOC 2: We are currently in SOC 2 Type II testing window; expected report completion is late Aug 2026. For now we need a mix: a current Type I / in-rotation attest (if available) plus the prefill so our security reviewers can start. Hard deadline: security committee wants a first pass by May 28.

2) HIPAA/PHI scope: Production endpoints that will carry PHI are: POST /v1/predict/patient, PUT /v1/patient/record/upload, and any asynchronous export to s3://novabio-prod-exports. Sandbox is non-PHI. We will need a BAA signed before production data is ingested.

3) Encryption & keys: For production we prefer customer-managed keys (BYOK), specifically AWS KMS CMKs or HSM-backed KMS. Sandbox can use provider-managed keys.

4) Data residency: EU-only for primary storage and backups; replication to US is not allowed by policy for the production bucket. Logs containing PHI must remain in EU.

5) Evidence transfer: We'd like a CAIQ prefill to speed reviewers, but ultimately expect a SIG with attachments. Preferred transfer is a shared Drive folder (we'll provide ACLs) for initial artifacts and DocuSign for legal (BAA).

Attachments: Novabio-SIG-Inventory.xlsx (high-level inventory, contains endpoint list)

I'll loop in Amy Chen (procurement) for the BAA and contracting timeline. If you can confirm whether Redwood supports BYOK for Dedicated/Private deployments that will help our infra team.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Torres
Information Security Manager — NovaBio Therapeutics
security@novabio.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novabio.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vendor questionnaire start — SOC 2 / HIPAA scope + clarifying asks

Hi Elena — great notes, thanks. Quick technical clarifications from our side: 

- BYOK: Redwood supports customer-managed keys for Dedicated and Private deployments via KMS/HSM integrations. For our hosted API we use Redwood-managed keys by default; however, we can scope an encrypted-only hosting model that uses a customer CMK for disk and secrets encryption when you opt for a Dedicated pool or Private deployment. I attach a short BYOK overview.

- Evidence workflow suggestion:
  1) We prefill the CAIQ with the basic controls and your inventory to get your reviewers started (fastest path).
  2) Parallel: we collect SIG attachments for infra-specific controls (KMS configuration, network diagrams, SOC-related policies).
  3) Legal: BAA via DocuSign after procurement confirms the contract.

Mutual action checklist (draft):
- May 18: Elena confirms PHI endpoints + shared Drive ACL.
- May 20: Redwood delivers CAIQ prefill + initial evidence list.
- May 26: Redwood uploads SIG attachments (KMS config, network diagram, incident response summary).
- Late May: Procurement and legal exchange BAA draft; Amy to confirm team.

Attachments: BYOK-overview.pdf, Redwood_KMS_Security_Brief.pdf

If you can confirm which environment(s) will hit the hosted API vs Dedicated/Private (so we map BYOK feasibility), we can finalize the prefill this week. Happy to jump on a 30-minute technical sync Monday morning.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Security Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
